name: q-portfolio
description: Q portfolio, a website on Cloudflare: shows which shares in a Quicken export are long-term, with the cost basis of every purchase.

scripts.dev: npm run sync && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler dev --ip 127.0.0.1
scripts.deploy: npm run sync && npm test && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy
